Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggsegverse (development version)

  • ggseg_atlas_repos() works out which packages are atlases from what they declare, not from their name: anything in the universe that builds on ggseg.formats and is not one of our own tools. The payload was already in hand, so this costs no extra request, and it falls back to the name shape if the API stops serving _dependencies.

  • installed_ggseg_atlases() warns when the r-universe lookup fails instead of reporting available = NA for every row, which the documentation says means the atlas is not hosted.

  • installed_atlas_packages() takes the library paths, so the DESCRIPTION filter and the cross-library dedup are testable.

Bug fixes

  • The documented install now works: Additional_repositories declares the ggsegverse r-universe, and the README installs from it. Nothing on CRAN can satisfy a dev-version floor, so the old pak::pak() line could only fail.

  • Raised the core package floors to the current development versions. They were stale, and a floor pairing ggseg.meshes before 0.0.1.9002 with ggseg3d after 2.1.2.9010 renders the cortex rotated 90 degrees in silence.

  • ggseg_atlas_repos() aborts with a readable message when the r-universe returns a body that is not a package table, instead of “incorrect number of dimensions”.

  • ggseg_atlas_repos() filters with grepl(), so value = TRUE errors rather than returning a row of NA.

  • installed_ggseg_atlases() reads your library rather than the r-universe, so it works offline and lists atlases you installed from elsewhere; available is NA when the r-universe cannot be reached.

  • The ggsegverse vignette maps data on label, not region. region repeats across hemispheres, so the example filled both of them.

  • Requires R >= 4.2, which is the floor of S7, and so of ggseg.formats. The package advertised an older R than its own dependency could install on.

  • The core packages are pinned. They were imported unversioned, so installing ggsegverse on a machine with older copies upgraded nothing and loaded an incoherent set – including a ggseg.formats whose tracula was mirrored left-to-right, which ggseg3d would then draw with the hemispheres swapped. A meta-package whose job is a coherent install has to say which versions are coherent.

  • Initial development version.

  • library(ggsegverse) attaches the core packages (ggseg.formats, ggseg, ggseg3d, ggseg.meshes, ggplot2) and prints a startup banner. Set options(ggsegverse.quiet = TRUE) to suppress it.

  • Added ggseg_atlas_repos(), install_ggseg_atlas(), install_ggseg_atlas_all() and installed_ggseg_atlases() to discover and install atlas packages from the ggsegverse r-universe.

  • Added ggsegverse_packages(), ggsegverse_deps(), ggsegverse_sitrep() and ggsegverse_update() to report and refresh core package versions.

  • Added ggsegverse_conflicts() to report masking between core packages and other attached packages, ignoring re-exports of the identical object.
